label: chartr · Durable sessions
description: From the chartr website. Works independently in any site layout.

items.title: Processes keep going
items.body: Thanks to [Herdr](https://herdr.dev/), processes and jobs live independently of the app window. Leave everything running without the chartr window, and come back to the same sessions.

items.title: Your layout comes back too
items.body: Reopen chartr to reconnect with your spaces, grouped tabs, pane arrangements, and active selection all restored like you never left.
